info.name: CalisHealth - Progression Rules
info.description: Postman checks for the Content Manager 'Progression Rules' screens (list, detail, create/edit, row actions) and for the member endpoint that judges a rule from MediaPipe counts. Set cmPassword (a CONTENT_MANAGER account) and memberEmail/memberPassword (an enabled MEMBER with a member profile), then run the whole collection in order with the Runner. Folder 1 reads the live data and picks free exercise pairs, so the rules created here never clash with existing ones or form a loop; folders 2-6 create, edit, evaluate and toggle those rules; folder 7 deletes them. Workout sessions and unlocked skills written for the member by folder 5 are not removed. Run it against a local/dev database, not production.
